gateway-activity-panel.description: Calls through this gateway from the last 30 days. Open a row to inspect its tool, redacted arguments, result, and decision.
gateway-activity-panel.emptyTitle: No calls have gone through this gateway yet.

gateway-advanced-panel.dangerDescription: Archiving takes the gateway offline for every client. Existing tokens stop working. Type the gateway name to confirm.
gateway-advanced-panel.confirmAriaLabel: Type the gateway name to confirm archive

overview-panel.toggleHint: Toggle the whole gateway off here.
overview-panel.whoCanUseHint: Anyone holding an active token below, restricted by the rules in the bound profile.
overview-panel.appsEmpty: This gateway’s profile doesn’t include any apps yet.

tokens-panel.issuedBody: Copy it now — you won’t see the full value again after leaving this page.
tokens-panel.intro: Issue a reusable token for an external client. Its name is also used as the client label.
tokens-panel.runtimeNote: Myrmidon creates a fresh one-hour runtime token when an agent run starts, then revokes it when the run ends. Codex can receive the same gateway through both an app connection and the managed-gateway path, so one run may leave two revoked rows. These are audit history, not repeated manual tokens.
tokens-panel.clientLabelHint: Also used as the client label.
tokens-panel.ownerNotePlaceholder: Who uses this token or why it exists
tokens-panel.newTokenHint: It is now available in Client snippets for a copy-ready configuration.
tokens-panel.empty: No tokens have been issued for this gateway.
tokens-panel.revokeDialogBody: Any client using <0>{{name}}</0> goes silent immediately. This can’t be undone. Type the token name to confirm.
tokens-panel.confirmAriaLabel: Type the token name to confirm

gateways-tab.issuedBody: {{name}} was created. Copy it now; it will not be shown again.
gateways-tab.pickProfileBody: A gateway needs an access profile before it can be created.
gateways-tab.pickActionsBody: Gateway tokens need at least one allowed MCP action.
gateways-tab.pageDescription: Stable endpoints for external clients that use the same profiles, rules, and audit trail as agent tool access.
gateways-tab.descriptionPlaceholder: Who this endpoint is for and when it should be rotated.
gateways-tab.noProfilesHint: Create an access profile before adding a gateway.
gateways-tab.empty: No named gateways yet. Create one here, then issue a token for the client that will connect to it.
gateways-tab.ownerNotePlaceholder: Who owns this token and why it exists

mcp-config-help-dialog.triggerAriaLabel: Get help creating an MCP config
mcp-config-help-dialog.title: Ask an agent for an MCP config
mcp-config-help-dialog.description: Don't know the URL or headers a tool needs? Hand this request to an agent and paste back what it gives you.
mcp-config-help-dialog.copyFailed: Couldn't copy automatically — select the text above and copy it.

paste-config-tab.oauthStartFailed: Myrmidon couldn’t start secure sign-in. Try again.
paste-config-tab.onlyRemoteHttp: Only remote HTTP drafts can be checked and activated from pasted config.
paste-config-tab.manualClientRequired: This server requires OAuth client details from its provider settings. Continue in setup to add them.
paste-config-tab.invalidJson: That doesn't look like valid JSON yet — paste the whole snippet, including the outer braces.
paste-config-tab.intro: Paste the MCP config snippet from the tool's README and we'll turn it into a friendly setup.
paste-config-tab.justUrl: Just a URL? <0>Browse planned app connections</0> instead.
paste-config-tab.pasteHint: Paste an MCP config — the snippet a README tells you to copy.
paste-config-tab.checkHint: We'll read it and show what we found before anything is saved.
paste-config-tab.noAppFound: We couldn't find an app in that config. Double-check you pasted the whole snippet.
paste-config-tab.foundApps_one: We found {{count}} app in that config
paste-config-tab.foundApps_other: We found {{count}} apps in that config
paste-config-tab.remoteNote: Checking a remote app creates a draft connection, stores any header replacements as Myrmidon secrets, and runs health/catalog discovery before activation.
paste-config-tab.localNote: We humanized the field names from the config. These run-in-your-workspace tools stay as drafts until an admin maps them to an approved template.
paste-config-tab.keysDraftOnly: Keys from this config stay draft-only until an admin maps them to an approved template.
paste-config-tab.noKeysNeeded: No keys needed for this one.
paste-config-tab.reviewHint: Health and catalog checks passed. Every discovered action starts allowed; you can narrow access after activation.

catalog.title: Tool catalog — {{name}}
catalog.empty: No tools discovered yet. Use “Refresh catalog” to discover tools from this connection.

connection-dialogs.addDescription: Choose an existing application or create one as part of the same connection flow. Credentials stay as vault references and the connection is probed before activation.
connection-dialogs.applicationTypeHint: Application type is inferred from the transport you choose next.
connection-dialogs.templateHint: Only board-approved command templates can run. Arbitrary commands are never accepted.
connection-dialogs.vaultHint: Free-text secrets are not accepted — pick a vault entry; Myrmidon stores only the <0>vault://</0> reference and resolves it at gateway use time.
connection-dialogs.probeLatencyNote: Probe latency is a single round-trip sample. Aggregate p95 latency across traffic is tracked on the Runtime tab once the connection is live.
